title: Internal Revenue Code – Title 26 USC (Bộ luật Thuế nội bộ)

versions.text:
Internal Revenue Code – Title 26, United States Code.
Subtitle A – Income Taxes. Chapter 1: Normal Taxes and Surtaxes. Section 1: Tax imposed on individuals. Section 11: Tax imposed on corporations. Subchapter B: Computation of Taxable Income. Section 61: Gross income defined. Section 63: Taxable income defined.
Subtitle B – Estate and Gift Taxes. Chapter 11: Estate Tax.
Subtitle C – Employment Taxes. Chapter 21: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA). Chapter 23: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA).
Subtitle D – Miscellaneous Excise Taxes.
Subtitle F – Procedure and Administration. Section 6011: General requirement of return. Section 6501: Limitations on assessment. Section 7201: Attempt to evade or defeat tax (felony).
